name: Wells Fargo Home Mortgage / Home Equity
notes: Researched from public wellsfargo.com mortgage pages only. Mortgage is managed inside Wells Fargo Online (Sign On with username and password; Enroll in Wells Fargo Online). Pay online, by phone (1-866-234-8271; home equity 1-866-439-3557) or in person at a branch. Automatic Mortgage Payment Options: monthly, twice a month, every other week or weekly withdrawals from any checking or savings account, splittable across up to four accounts; enroll online via Transfer & Pay > Pay WF Accounts, by phone at 1-866-386-8519, or by fax. The engine models only monthly autopay from one bank account (frequencies and splits are help text). No fees listed; no card payments described (bank-only inferred). Online statements kept up to 7 years. Payment help: forbearance, repayment plan, modification, short sale, deed-in-lieu via 1-800-678-7986. Mailing address not published on the page, so pay_by_mail stays as catalog.

autopay.note: Monthly, twice-a-month, every-other-week or weekly withdrawals; enroll online, by phone at 1-866-386-8519 or by fax.

help.title: Ways to pay your mortgage
paragraphs: Sign on to Wells Fargo Online to make a payment, view statements and set up payment alerts. You can also pay by phone at 1-866-234-8271 (home equity: 1-866-439-3557), Monday to Friday 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Central, or pay in person at a Wells Fargo location.
Online mortgage statements are available for up to 7 years; tax documents are also available after you sign on.

help.title: Automatic Mortgage Payment Options
paragraphs: Automatic withdrawals can be scheduled monthly, twice a month (half the payment each time), every other week (half the payment each time) or weekly (a quarter of the payment each time), from any checking or savings account. A payment can be split among up to four accounts.

Monthly and twice-a-month schedules make 12 monthly payments a year; weekly and every-other-week schedules make 13, which can lower total interest. Weekly and every-other-week amounts are treated as partial payments and may not be applied until a full monthly payment has been received.
steps: Sign on to Wells Fargo Online.
Select Pay WF Accounts and set up the automatic mortgage payment.
Or call 1-866-386-8519 after reading the terms, or fax the enrollment form to 1-866-287-6241.

help.title: Mortgage payment help
paragraphs: If you are facing a hardship, options to stay in your home include forbearance (temporarily reduced or suspended payments that come due later), a repayment plan to catch up on missed payments, and a loan modification for longer-term hardship.
If you cannot stay, a short sale or deed-in-lieu of foreclosure may be possible. Call 1-800-678-7986 to start; help is free, and Wells Fargo responds within 30 days after you submit documents.

extra.intent: Using the Wells Fargo website help pages, find the phone number for enrolling in automatic mortgage payments by phone. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using the Wells Fargo help pages, find what share of the total monthly mortgage payment is withdrawn each time on the weekly automatic payment schedule. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Weekly withdrawals take a quarter (1/4) of the payment each time.
